text: I'm a childminder and one of my little ones, a 5 month old boy, has come out in chickenpox spots this evening. His mum's asked me to keep him tonight. They're really itchy, he keeps rubbing at them and I'm scared he'll make them sore. Other than that he's himself, feeding and smiling. I just panicked because he's so tiny. Is there anything safe I can put on them at his age?
